definition: Products the daily article loop can send readers to. 'anicca' is the self-owned product (existing default). 'capafy-skills' points at our own best-selling Capafy listings so article traffic also feeds Capafy sales, not only aniccaai.com signups.

tracking.evidence: skills/earn/capafy-marketing/scripts/capafy_hourly_reconcile.py _traffic_merge() + skills/earn/capafy-marketing/tests/test_capafy_hourly_reconcile.py (rows captured 2026-09-28 from Capafy's own POST /app/developer/traffic-sources/v2/{visits,sales}/stats). A capafy.ai/agent/<id>?ct=<value> visit is reported back as sourceType="ct" sourceName="<value>", and a matching sale is reported as sourceType="campaign" campaignName="<value>" -- so a distinct ct= token per skill makes each skill's article-driven visits and orders visible as its own row in Capafy's own dashboard, independent of our internal money_ledger join. We reuse this proven, already-live mechanism instead of an unverified utm_source/utm_campaign guess.

hook-lab.buyer_problem: the first three seconds of a short-form video keep getting scrolled past; the creator needs a hook that survives the swipe.

marketing-strategist.buyer_problem: a small team has no dedicated marketer and needs a concrete campaign/content plan, not generic advice.

reels-hook-lab.buyer_problem: an Instagram Reels creator's completion rate drops in the opening frame and needs a proven hook pattern for Reels specifically.

slide-maker.buyer_problem: turning a raw outline into a presentable slide deck eats hours the person doesn't have before a pitch or class.

tiktok-script-pro.buyer_problem: a TikTok creator can film and edit but freezes at a blank page when it's time to write the script.

youtube-script-writer.buyer_problem: a YouTuber's upload cadence stalls because scripting each video takes longer than shooting it.
